title: Spring Boot 3 & Microservices Architecture
description: A comprehensive, step-by-step staircase roadmap from foundational build tools and networking to Spring Framework core, Spring Boot 3 REST APIs, JPA persistence, cloud-native infrastructure, distributed messaging, and Kubernetes orchestration.

modules.title: Build Tools (Apache Maven)
modules.description: Build lifecycle management, POM coordinates, dependency resolution graphs, plugins, and production packaging.

lessons.title: Maven Architecture & Build Lifecycle (POM, Plugins, Lifecycle Phases)
lessons.description: Coordinates (groupId, artifactId, version), dependency tree scopes, plugin execution goals, and standard lifecycle phases (compile, test, package, install).

modules.title: Basic Networking & Relational Databases
modules.description: HTTP wire protocol, status code semantics, header negotiation, SQL query mechanics, and ACID guarantees.

lessons.title: HTTP Protocol Internals: Methods, Status Codes, Headers & Cookies
lessons.description: HTTP request/response framing, idempotency across GET/PUT/DELETE/PATCH, cache headers, cookies, and 2xx/3xx/4xx/5xx status code taxonomy.

lessons.title: Relational Database Fundamentals: SQL Joins, Indexes, ACID & Normalization
lessons.description: Relational modeling, inner/outer joins, B-Tree index scan vs sequential scan, normalization forms, and ACID transaction guarantees under load.

modules.title: Inversion of Control (IoC) & Dependency Injection (DI)
modules.description: Decoupling component lifecycles, inversion of control architecture, and comparing injection strategies.

lessons.title: Why Dependency Injection? Decoupling, Testability & Separation of Concerns
lessons.description: Why DI? Decoupling class coupling, testability through test doubles, and separation of creation concerns from business execution.

lessons.title: Dependency Injection Variants: Constructor, Setter & Field Injection
lessons.description: Why constructor injection is the gold standard (immutability, fail-fast null safety), setter injection for optional dependencies, and why field injection is an anti-pattern.

modules.title: Spring ApplicationContext & Bean Lifecycle
modules.description: Container instantiation, bean definition registries, scoping semantics, and lifecycle callback execution.

lessons.title: BeanFactory vs ApplicationContext & Bean Scopes (Singleton, Prototype, Web)
lessons.description: BeanFactory lazy initialization vs ApplicationContext pre-instantiation, bean naming, and thread safety across singleton, prototype, request, and session scopes.

lessons.title: Bean Lifecycle Callbacks: Initialization, Destruction & Post-Processors
lessons.description: Complete lifecycle traversal: @PostConstruct, @PreDestroy, InitializingBean, DisposableBean, and BeanPostProcessor hook mechanics.

modules.title: Spring Configuration Approaches
modules.description: Stereotype annotations, Java-based configuration, component scanning, and dependency resolution disambiguation.

lessons.title: Annotation-Driven Configuration: @Configuration, @Bean & Component Scanning
lessons.description: @Configuration CGLIB proxy semantics, @Bean factory methods, and stereotype discovery (@Component, @Service, @Repository, @ComponentScan).

lessons.title: Bean Disambiguation: @Autowired, @Qualifier & @Primary Resolution
lessons.description: Resolving NoUniqueBeanDefinitionException using @Qualifier, setting default fallbacks with @Primary, and collection injection patterns.

modules.title: Spring Expression Language (SpEL) & Environment
modules.description: Runtime expression parsing, dynamic property evaluation, and external configuration loading.

lessons.title: Reading Properties with @Value, Profiles & SpEL Evaluation
lessons.description: Injecting properties with @Value, SpEL syntax (#{...}), Environment property sources, and dynamic @Profile activation.

modules.title: Aspect-Oriented Programming (Spring AOP)
modules.description: Decoupling cross-cutting concerns, pointcut expression languages, and runtime proxy interception.

lessons.title: AOP Core Primitives: Cross-Cutting Concerns, Pointcuts & JoinPoints
lessons.description: Decomposing cross-cutting concerns: Aspects, JoinPoints, Pointcut expression syntax (execution, within, @annotation), and JDK Dynamic Proxy vs CGLIB.

lessons.title: Practical Advices: Intercepting Logging, Performance Timing & Transactions
lessons.description: Writing production advices: @Before input validation, @AfterReturning audits, and @Around ProceedingJoinPoint for method execution telemetry.

modules.title: Spring Boot 3 Fundamentals
modules.description: Conventions over configuration, bootstrap sequences, auto-configuration conditions, and container runtimes.

lessons.title: Opinionated Conventions & Spring Initializr Anatomy
lessons.description: Starter dependencies, dependency management BOMs, and the anatomy of @SpringBootApplication (@Configuration + @EnableAutoConfiguration + @ComponentScan).

lessons.title: Embedded Servlet Containers: Tomcat, Jetty, Undertow & Thread Models
lessons.description: How Spring Boot configures embedded web servers, comparing Tomcat blocking worker pools with Undertow XNIO non-blocking architectures.

lessons.title: External Configuration: YAML Hierarchy, Profiles & @ConfigurationProperties
lessons.description: application.properties vs application.yml, property precedence order, profile-specific files (application-prod.yml), and type-safe @ConfigurationProperties validation.

lessons.title: Executable Packaging & CDS Optimization
lessons.description: Fat JAR layout, BOOT-INF classes, layered container builds, and Class Data Sharing (CDS) to cut startup latency.

modules.title: Building RESTful APIs with Spring MVC
modules.description: DispatcherServlet pipeline, request mapping mechanics, parameter binding, and response envelope structuring.

lessons.title: Spring MVC Architecture: DispatcherServlet, HandlerMappings & HttpMessageConverters
lessons.description: The anatomy of an incoming HTTP request: DispatcherServlet dispatch loop, HandlerMapping resolution, HandlerAdapter invocation, and Jackson JSON serialization.

lessons.title: REST Controllers: @RestController, Path Variables, Request Bodies & Headers
lessons.description: Developing clean REST endpoints: @GetMapping, @PostMapping, @PutMapping, @DeleteMapping, @PatchMapping, @PathVariable, @RequestParam, @RequestBody, and @RequestHeader.

lessons.title: Response Handling: ResponseEntity, Status Codes & Custom Response Envelopes
lessons.description: Crafting consistent API contracts: ResponseEntity<T>, setting Location headers on 201 Created, 204 No Content, and unified enterprise response envelopes.

modules.title: Input Validation (Jakarta Validation)
modules.description: Declarative request validation, constraint enforcement, and custom validator implementation.

lessons.title: Declarative Request Validation: Constraints, @Valid & @Validated
lessons.description: Applying standard constraints: @NotNull, @NotBlank, @Size, @Min, @Max, @Email, @Pattern, and distinguishing method-level @Validated from parameter @Valid.

lessons.title: Custom Constraint Annotations & Custom Validator Implementation
lessons.description: Authoring custom validation logic: creating ConstraintValidator<A, T> implementations, composing constraints, and dynamic error payload messages.

modules.title: Global Exception Handling
modules.description: Centralized controller advisories, HTTP status mapping, and the RFC 7807 ProblemDetail standard.

lessons.title: Controller Advisories: @RestControllerAdvice & @ExceptionHandler Mechanics
lessons.description: Intercepting controller exceptions globally, mapping domain exceptions to HTTP statuses, and handling MethodArgumentNotValidException payloads.

lessons.title: Modern RFC 7807 Standard: ProblemDetail API in Spring Boot 3
lessons.description: Implementing RFC 7807 problem details: using Spring Boot 3 ProblemDetail class, custom properties, URI instance identifiers, and standardized error schemas.

modules.title: Layered Architecture & DTO Mapping
modules.description: Controller-Service-Repository boundaries, entity encapsulation, and compile-time DTO transformation.

lessons.title: Strict Layered Boundaries: Controller to Service to Repository Isolation
lessons.description: Why entities must never escape the service layer, single responsibility across web, service, and persistence tiers, and circular dependency avoidance.

lessons.title: DTO Pattern with Java Records & Compile-Time MapStruct Mapping
lessons.description: Data Transfer Objects using modern Java records, eliminating reflection overhead via compile-time MapStruct code generation, and comparing with ModelMapper.

modules.title: ORM Fundamentals & Hibernate Entity Mapping
modules.description: Object-relational impedance mismatch, JPA specification vs Hibernate provider, and core entity mapping.

lessons.title: Object-Relational Impedance Mismatch & JPA vs Hibernate Specifications
lessons.description: The five dimensions of impedance mismatch (granularity, subtypes, identity, associations, navigation), JPA standards, and Hibernate Session / EntityManager mechanics.

lessons.title: Domain Entity Mapping: @Entity, Identifiers, Columns & Value Types
lessons.description: Mapping relational tables: @Entity, @Table, @Id strategies (IDENTITY, SEQUENCE, TABLE), @Column attributes, @Enumerated (STRING vs ORDINAL), and @Embedded value objects.

modules.title: Entity Relationships & Performance Tuning
modules.description: Bidirectional associations, cascade propagation, fetch strategies, and resolving N+1 select queries.

lessons.title: Associations & Cascade Strategies: @OneToMany, @ManyToOne, @ManyToMany
lessons.description: Owning vs inverse side (mappedBy), bidirectional sync helper methods, CascadeType semantics (PERSIST, MERGE, REMOVE), and orphanRemoval.

lessons.title: Eliminating the N+1 Query Problem: JOIN FETCH & Dynamic @EntityGraph
lessons.description: Why FetchType.EAGER is a production hazard, lazy loading mechanics, bytecode enhancement, and solving N+1 query storms using JOIN FETCH queries and JPA @EntityGraph.

modules.title: Spring Data JPA Repositories
modules.description: Repository abstraction layers, derived queries, JPQL vs native SQL, and server-side pagination.

lessons.title: Repository Hierarchy: CrudRepository to JpaRepository Abstractions
lessons.description: Repository $ightarrow$ CrudRepository $ightarrow$ PagingAndSortingRepository $ightarrow$ JpaRepository contract hierarchy and query method proxy generation.

lessons.title: Derived Queries & Custom JPQL / Native Queries with @Query
lessons.description: Method name query derivation heuristics (findByEmailAndStatus), type-safe JPQL vs database-specific Native SQL, and bulk updates with @Modifying.

lessons.title: Pagination, Sorting & Slice Query Execution
lessons.description: High-volume query pagination: Pageable, Sort orders, comparing Page<T> (executes count(*) query) vs Slice<T> (infinite scrolling with zero count overhead).

modules.title: Transaction Management with @Transactional
modules.description: ACID transactional boundaries, propagation levels, isolation mechanics, and dynamic proxy bypass traps.

lessons.title: Transaction Boundaries: Propagation, Isolation Levels, readOnly & Rollback Semantics
lessons.description: REQUIRED vs REQUIRES_NEW, isolation levels (READ_COMMITTED, REPEATABLE_READ, SERIALIZABLE), readOnly = true dirty-checking bypass, and self-invocation proxy bypass pitfalls.

modules.title: Database Migrations with Flyway & Liquibase
modules.description: Deterministic database versioning, zero-downtime schema evolution, and production migration best practices.

lessons.title: Automated Schema Evolution: Versioned Migrations with Flyway in Production
lessons.description: Why ddl-auto: update destroys production data, SQL migration naming conventions (V1__init.sql, R__views.sql), schema baseline tables, and backward-compatible schema changes.

modules.title: Spring Security 6 & Modern Stateless Authentication
modules.description: Security filter chain lifecycle, lambda DSL configuration, stateless JWT authentication, and method security.

lessons.title: SecurityFilterChain Architecture & Non-Deprecated Lambda DSL Configuration
lessons.description: Replacing legacy WebSecurityConfigurerAdapter: configuring SecurityFilterChain bean, authorizeHttpRequests lambda DSL, AuthenticationManager, and BCryptPasswordEncoder.

lessons.title: Stateless Authentication with JWT: Issuance, Signature Verification & Claims
lessons.description: Building a stateless JWT filter: token generation (HMAC/RSA), extracting claims, signature verification, and populating SecurityContextHolder without server sessions.

lessons.title: Role-Based Access Control (RBAC) & Method Security with @PreAuthorize
lessons.description: Enabling method security with @EnableMethodSecurity: hasRole vs hasAuthority, SpEL expressions in @PreAuthorize, and securing service methods.

modules.title: Testing Spring Boot Applications
modules.description: Testing pyramid, unit tests with Mockito, web and JPA slice tests, and containerized integration tests.

lessons.title: Unit Testing with JUnit 5 & Mockito: Strict Isolation & Stubs
lessons.description: Fast isolated unit tests: JUnit 5 lifecycle (@Test, @ParameterizedTest), Mockito annotations (@Mock, @InjectMocks), stubbing with when(), and asserting invocations with verify().

lessons.title: Slice Testing: Web Layer (@WebMvcTest) & Persistence Layer (@DataJpaTest)
lessons.description: Targeted slice testing: MockMvc controller assertions with @WebMvcTest, in-memory repository tests with @DataJpaTest, and TestEntityManager.

lessons.title: Integration Testing with Testcontainers: Real PostgreSQL & MySQL Containers
lessons.description: Eliminating H2 in-memory divergence: running disposable Docker database containers during maven test via Testcontainers and @DynamicPropertySource.

modules.title: Observability, Actuator & Health Checks
modules.description: Production metrics telemetry, custom health indicators, structured logging, and OpenAPI documentation.

lessons.title: Spring Boot Actuator Production Endpoints, Metrics & Custom HealthIndicators
lessons.description: Exposing /actuator/health, /actuator/metrics, /actuator/info, securing actuator management ports, and authoring custom HealthIndicator classes for downstream probes.

lessons.title: Structured Logging with SLF4J/Logback & OpenAPI Spec Generation with Springdoc
lessons.description: JSON-formatted logstash encoders for log aggregators, MDC correlation IDs, and automated Swagger UI generation via springdoc-openapi-starter-webmvc-ui.

modules.title: Monolith vs. Microservices Architectural Trade-offs
modules.description: Modular monolith design, distributed computing fallacies, organizational coupling, and service extraction criteria.

lessons.title: Modular Monoliths vs Microservices & The Fallacies of Distributed Computing
lessons.description: When microservices are the wrong choice, modular boundaries with Spring Modulith, and the 8 Fallacies of Distributed Computing (latency is not zero, network is unreliable).

modules.title: Domain-Driven Design (DDD) Fundamentals
modules.description: Strategic domain modeling, ubiquitous language, bounded contexts, and preventing distributed monoliths.

lessons.title: Strategic DDD: Bounded Contexts, Ubiquitous Language & Context Mapping
lessons.description: Decomposing enterprise domains: identifying core, supporting, and generic subdomains, establishing context boundaries, and defining upstream/downstream context maps.

lessons.title: Subdomain Classification & Preventing the Distributed Monolith Anti-Pattern
lessons.description: Identifying anti-patterns: shared domain models, synchronized lockstep deployments, and chatty inter-service synchronous dependency webs.

modules.title: Database per Microservice & Data Boundaries
modules.description: Service data isolation, multi-tenancy models, and eventual consistency across distributed boundaries.

lessons.title: Service Autonomy & Multi-Tenant Database Isolation Strategies
lessons.description: Why microservices must never share a database, comparative analysis of Database-per-tenant, Schema-per-tenant, and Column Discriminator models.

lessons.title: Distributed Data Synchronization & Consistency Challenges
lessons.description: Embracing eventual consistency: eliminating distributed database foreign keys, asynchronous replication streams, and event-driven data hydration.

modules.title: Centralized Configuration (Spring Cloud Config)
modules.description: Centralized repository configuration, Git and Vault backends, and dynamic property refresh with Spring Cloud Bus.

lessons.title: Centralized Configuration Server with Git & HashiCorp Vault Backends
lessons.description: Setting up Spring Cloud Config Server: externalizing application.yml to Git, secret encryption with Vault, and bootstrap configuration injection.

lessons.title: Dynamic Runtime Refresh with @RefreshScope & Spring Cloud Bus
lessons.description: Runtime property reloads without application restarts: @RefreshScope bean re-instantiation, actuator /actuator/refresh, and broadcast webhooks via Kafka/RabbitMQ Bus.

modules.title: Service Registration & Discovery
modules.description: Service registry topologies, dynamic ephemeral IP address resolution, and client-side load balancing.

lessons.title: Eureka Server Registry Topology, Heartbeats & Client-Side Load Balancing
lessons.description: Netflix Eureka server and client integration, heartbeat renewal leases, self-preservation mode, and client-side load balancing with Spring Cloud LoadBalancer.

modules.title: Inter-Service Synchronous Communication
modules.description: Synchronous RPC communication, modern WebClient, Spring 6 HTTP Interfaces, and declarative OpenFeign clients.

lessons.title: RestTemplate vs WebClient vs Spring 6 Declarative HTTP Interfaces
lessons.description: Deprecating RestTemplate: non-blocking reactive WebClient calls, and Spring 6 @HttpExchange declarative client interfaces with auto-generated proxies.

lessons.title: Declarative Inter-Service RPC with Spring Cloud OpenFeign
lessons.description: Declaring typed interfaces with @FeignClient, request interceptors for auth headers, custom error decoders, and integrating client-side load balancers.

modules.title: API Gateway (Spring Cloud Gateway)
modules.description: Reactive Netty edge proxying, route predicates, filter transformation pipelines, and centralized rate limiting.

lessons.title: Reactive Netty Ingress Architecture: Routes, Predicates & Filter Pipelines
lessons.description: Spring Cloud Gateway built on Project Reactor & Netty: route mapping, Path/Method/Header predicates, and pre/post GatewayFilter factories.

lessons.title: Edge Concerns: Token Bucket Rate Limiting, CORS & JWT Header Forwarding
lessons.description: Production edge enforcement: Redis-backed token bucket rate limiting (RequestRateLimiter), cross-origin resource sharing, and token relay to internal microservices.

modules.title: Resiliency & Fault Tolerance (Resilience4j)
modules.description: Circuit breakers, retry mechanisms with exponential backoff, rate limiters, and thread pool bulkheads.

lessons.title: Circuit Breaker State Machine: Closed, Open, Half-Open & Fallback Recovery
lessons.description: Resilience4j circuit breaker mechanics: sliding window metrics (count-based vs time-based), failure rate thresholds, state transitions, and graceful degradation via fallbackMethod.

lessons.title: Retry with Exponential Backoff, Rate Limiter & Thread Pool Bulkheads
lessons.description: Preventing thundering herds: exponential backoff with randomized jitter, bulkhead thread pool isolation to prevent cascading resource starvation.

modules.title: Asynchronous Messaging with Apache Kafka & RabbitMQ
modules.description: Event-driven communication, message broker topologies, Kafka partition mechanics, and consumer groups.

lessons.title: Message Broker Selection: Apache Kafka vs RabbitMQ Architectural Trade-offs
lessons.description: AMQP smart broker/dumb consumer model (RabbitMQ) vs distributed append-only commit log (Kafka): throughput, message ordering, and retention semantics.

lessons.title: Kafka Fundamentals: Topics, Partitions, Offsets & Consumer Groups
lessons.description: Kafka internal layout: log segments, partition rebalances, consumer offset commit strategies (at-most-once, at-least-once, effectively-once), and producer partition keys.

lessons.title: Event-Driven Microservices with Spring for Apache Kafka & Spring Cloud Stream
lessons.description: Writing resilient Kafka producers with KafkaTemplate, concurrent message listeners with @KafkaListener, error handler Dead Letter Topics (DLT), and Spring Cloud Stream functional binders.

modules.title: Distributed Transactions & Data Consistency
modules.description: The 2PC dilemma, Saga pattern orchestration vs choreography, Transactional Outbox, and CQRS.

lessons.title: The 2PC Dilemma & Saga Pattern: Orchestration vs Choreography
lessons.description: Why Two-Phase Commit fails in microservices, implementing Saga transactions via Choreography (event-driven reactions) vs Orchestration (central state coordinator), and compensating actions.

lessons.title: Transactional Outbox Pattern & CDC Streaming with Debezium
lessons.description: Eliminating dual-write inconsistencies between RDBMS and Kafka: local outbox table transactions, PostgreSQL WAL tailing with Debezium CDC for guaranteed at-least-once delivery.

lessons.title: Command Query Responsibility Segregation (CQRS) Architecture
lessons.description: Separating write models (relational transactional stores) from read models (Elasticsearch / Redis query projections) via asynchronous materialized view streams.

modules.title: Distributed Tracing & Centralized Observability
modules.description: Correlation ID propagation, Micrometer Tracing with Zipkin/Tempo, Prometheus metrics, and centralized logs.

lessons.title: Distributed Tracing with Micrometer Tracing & Zipkin / Grafana Tempo
lessons.description: End-to-end request tracing in Spring Boot 3: replacing Sleuth with Micrometer Tracing, traceId and spanId propagation across HTTP and Kafka headers, and visualizing spans in Zipkin/Tempo.

lessons.title: Prometheus Metrics Scraping & Centralized Logging with Loki / ELK Stack
lessons.description: Scraping Actuator metrics via Prometheus, building Grafana telemetry dashboards (P99 latency, JVM heap, thread count), and aggregating structured JSON logs via Grafana Loki or ELK.

modules.title: Distributed Security & OAuth2 Token Relay
modules.description: Centralized Identity Providers, Keycloak integration, OAuth2/OIDC PKCE flows, and token relay architectures.

lessons.title: Centralized Identity Provider Integration (Keycloak / Auth0) & OIDC PKCE Flow
lessons.description: Setting up Keycloak realm clients, authorization code flow with Proof Key for Code Exchange (PKCE), user credential delegation, and SSO token issuance.

lessons.title: API Gateway Token Relay & Microservice Downstream JWT Verification
lessons.description: Securing the perimeter: API Gateway validates incoming bearer tokens, extracts user claims, and relays verified JWT headers down to internal services without internal re-authentication.

lessons.title: Containerizing Spring Boot: Multi-Stage Builds, Layertools & Cloud-Native Buildpacks
lessons.description: Optimizing container images: extracting Spring Boot layertools JAR layers, multi-stage Docker caching, and generating container images without Dockerfiles via Cloud-Native Buildpacks.

lessons.title: Local Multi-Service Orchestration with Docker Compose
lessons.description: Orchestrating microservices locally: defining docker-compose.yml for microservice containers, PostgreSQL, Apache Kafka, Redis, Zipkin, and Keycloak with healthcheck dependencies.

lessons.title: K8s Architecture: Pods, Deployments, ReplicaSets & Cluster Services
lessons.description: Container orchestration primitives: Pod lifecycles, Deployments with rolling updates, ReplicaSets, and ClusterIP / NodePort / LoadBalancer service topologies.

lessons.description: Production K8s configurations: injecting ConfigMaps & Secrets, configuring Ingress controllers, and binding Spring Boot Actuator probes to K8s livenessProbe and readinessProbe.

lessons.title: Kubernetes Native Service Discovery vs Eureka Replacement
lessons.description: Why cloud-native deployments discard Eureka: leveraging Kubernetes CoreDNS and native K8s Service abstractions for transparent internal service discovery and load balancing.

modules.description: Automated verification pipelines, linting, Testcontainers integration testing, and production registry publishing.

lessons.description: Building enterprise CI/CD pipelines with GitHub Actions: automated linting, unit tests, Docker-in-Docker Testcontainers execution, image building, vulnerability scanning, and container registry publishing.

lessons.description: Token bucket rate-limiting algorithms, Envoy filter chains, and Resilience4j state machines.

lessons.description: Eliminating two-phase commit (2PC) using Postgres WAL tailing and Debezium for at-least-once message delivery.

lessons.description: Compensating transactions, temporal deadlocks, and event storming for distributed consistency.
